reviews.review:
My 2nd review for this company. I wrote one for Vera before. Haven't really been bothered to review Exodus or Saven but both were good games. I played all 4 games from Horrawr. This one really needs my review tho because I particularly like it. Above average. It's a very great game.

At first I was overthinking it. It took me a few hours to realize this game isn't that complicated. I was making it harder on myself. At first I thought the icons had something to do with the tricks. I can now tell you they don't. Pure cosmetics. And at first I was trying to activate each change. I then realized you don't need to do that extra work. It's simply a yes or no choice. If there was no change at all -> go forward. If anything changed -> go backwards. You only need to make 6 correct choices. If you're lucky enough, you can probably guess your way out. But why do that? Actually play and enjoy the game, it's very fun.

And a second note. It's good for a horror game. The tricks of the tomb really start to annoy or bother you. It phyicologically scares you. Yes, that's horror. The puzzles are scary. (I'm actually brave tho, so I finished the game). But it makes good for a horror game. Specifically, I like that mummy encounter. Sometimes, if he's not in the room, he'll jump you when you exit. So, be warned. That was really good. 

In conclusion good game. I think it was a worthwhile way to spend my time. You too.
